title_en: Doctors and Pharmacies (15/20): An Athlete's Ankle Injury
note_en: 又……又…… links two adjectives that are both true at once: 脚踝又疼又肿 "his ankle was both painful and swollen." English just says "sore and swollen," but Chinese puts 又 before each adjective, and it works best when the two qualities point the same way (both bad or both good).
